levels.label: Clean/conflict outcomes
levels.status_display: Merge tree and conflict file are explicit
levels.allowed_claim: The simulator can report bounded clean and conflicting local merge-tree results with exact inputs.
levels.forbidden_inference: A mergeable tree has passed behavioral verification.

levels.label: Ref safety
levels.allowed_claim: The local simulation leaves source and target refs untouched.
levels.forbidden_inference: The simulator protects against every external or concurrent mutation.

levels.label: Declared gate handoff
levels.status_display: Local gate probe is separate, not integrated
levels.allowed_claim: A local gate result can be recorded against a target commit as a distinct probe.
levels.forbidden_inference: Workflow Gateboard has executed inside the simulated state.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The integration case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
